accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Papers were initially arranged and described by Sara L. Engelhardt during a visit to RAC in 2010.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Papers donated to Rockefeller Archive Center by Sara L. Engelhardt.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Loosely arranged in series by file type.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Sara L. Engelhardt papers document her career in philanthropic administration, focusing primarily on her work as President of the Foundation Center including correspondence, meeting and committee records, projects, collaborative efforts, program and strategic planning, and professional activities.
